payload.reason: The evidence indicates that analyzing self-attention functions in the last layer of the BERT model is relevant due to the correlation with human attention and the stability of attention functions across layers during fine-tuning.

claims.text: The self-attention functions in the last layer of BERT are analyzed because they show a correlation with human attention, which is crucial for understanding model predictions.
Attention functions in earlier layers of BERT do not change significantly during fine-tuning, making the last layer's attention more relevant for analysis.
Selecting the highest correlating head in the last layer produces weaker correlations than attention flows, indicating the last layer's attention may not reliably correspond to token relevance.
